intro-description.default: Not every day needs a personal best. Just a place to start.
intro-description.compact: Not every day needs a personal best. Just a place to start.
intro-description.expanded: Some days bring a little more room for movement. Others call for an easy beginning, a slower pace, and the freedom to change your plans. This journal keeps that space open without turning every session into a competition.

session-description.default: A little rhythm. A little effort. Enough room to finish feeling like you.
session-description.compact: A little rhythm. A little effort. Enough room to finish feeling like you.
session-description.expanded: Begin gently, build into a steady middle, and leave enough room to ease back. You can pause whenever you need to. The timer and your journal keep their place while you choose a different direction, revisit the details, or take a little longer to decide.
